pages.html:
Sample HTML page

One page, written as HTML, rendered by the site engine.

This page comes from a schema 2 release. The engine cleans the HTML and CSS on every request, scopes the CSS to the page, and renders islands for anything interactive.

Send an enquiry See services

How the page is built

  • HTML

    Sections, headings, links and images from an allow-list. No scripts and no inline handlers.

  • CSS

    Page CSS is prefixed so it can only style this page, never the header or footer.

  • Islands

    Forms and tools are placed with a tag and rendered by the engine from its registry.
